name: corruptorfun
description: A collection of browser-only toys that corrupt data and render the result.

scripts.build:wasm: cd emu && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p ps1 --lib && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('../src/wasm',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/ps1.wasm','../src/wasm/ps1.wasm')"
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js && cd emu && cargo test --release
